Method: synopsis cosine scores become Euclidean chord distances √(2(1−similarity)). Both layouts are evaluated against the same targets after fitting one uniform scale. MDS uses 16 deterministic starts and minimizes squared distance error. Relative weights are retained; personal magnets add explicit anchor constraints. Poster collision offsets are measured separately and shown with dotted leaders in the prototype. No private participant labels were used in this benchmark.

Distance error is normalized stress, not a percentage of incorrect judgments. Two dimensions cannot preserve every pair distance. Neighbor retention is a separate check, not the optimization objective. These results describe this ten-film dataset, not all media. Metadata ties use stable movie-index ordering. Compact displays can lose neighbors after poster spacing.
